benchmark_name: Curify Visual Search Benchmark - 68-query gold set
source_repository: internal (not public) - Curify daily-report/evaluation working repository
source_commit: 32cb4c3 (query list and raw automated collection); 04f8d79 (Claude-generated relevance labels added)
evaluation_date: 2026-07-07 (automated collection and Claude labeling); 2026-07-09/10 (labels finalized, human review column added but never filled)
transformation_summary: queries.csv: copied verbatim from gold_query_test_set_2026-07-07.csv with a deterministic query_id (q001-q068) added in original row order; no other column changes. automated_relevance_labels.csv: copied from curify_search_auto_collect_with_claude_relevance_2026-07-07.csv joined to query_id by exact query-text match; dropped the manual_relevant_count/manual_irrelevant_count/manual_recall_status/manual_filtering_status/manual_content_gap/manual_issue_type/manual_notes columns (all 68 rows were 100% empty in the source - human review was scoped but never performed) and dropped screenshot_path/top_10_result_links (local repo-relative screenshot paths and long tracking-parameter URLs not meaningful outside this repo). No query text, label values, or scores were altered.
known_limitations: Evaluation covers Curify only. Cross-platform screenshots (Pinterest/Bing/Google/Canva) exist internally for only 12 of the 68 queries and are not included in this release (image files are not published; the labels attached to them were an AI visual read, not a platform-level score).

The claude_relevance_label/claude_issue_type/claude_relevance_reason/claude_confidence fields are single-pass judgments generated by an LLM (Claude) reading the automated collection output; they are not a human review. A human-review rubric and column set were prepared (see docs) but 0 of 68 rows were ever filled in by a human reviewer.
No diversity or actionability scoring dimension exists in the source data for this benchmark.
This is a point-in-time snapshot of Curify search results captured 2026-07-07; results will differ from current production Curify search.
